scope: Initial fitting and validation; no test performance scoring
history_rule: Eligible 2026 attempts on strictly earlier calendar dates from game StartTimestamp; all same-date games share frozen history
c1_fit_rule: Fit shared coefficients on all fitting rows; zero history has h=0. Apply B directly at prediction time when history is absent or thrower is unknown.
c2_fit_rule: Normal random intercept per known thrower; estimate population intercept, xCP log-odds slope, and random-intercept standard deviation by marginal maximum likelihood on fitting games. Unknown throwers use B and are omitted from the random-effects likelihood.
c2_prediction_rule: Integrate predicted probabilities over the player posterior from strictly earlier dates; B directly for no history or unknown throwers
selection_metric: Mean validation log loss, lower is better
tie_break: Within 1e-10 log loss: prefer B over C, C1 over C2, and larger k among C1 candidates
bootstrap_unit: Whole game, paired across models; fixed fitted models and history path
older_season_xcp_provenance: Unverified; no older seasons used for fitting or player history
test_status: Reserved; this command does not produce test predictions or metrics
interpretation: Retrospective context-conditioned prediction; validation performance is used for selection and cannot establish final improvement. Prior project work has inspected 2026.
